title: JevLint-LE project settings
description: Lint settings for this project. The editor and the command line both read this file, so they report the same findings.

rules.description: The level of a rule, by its code. A rule not listed keeps its default.

fallbackOptions.description: Option names that count as a fallback for a Choice, such as other or none.

ignore.description: Findings to leave out, each written as a rule code, a colon and a question id: JEV004:department.
